say.never: A command is a little program with four parts, and WPILib calls them for you at the right times. `initialize` runs **once** at the start. `execute` runs again and again, every 20 thousandths of a second. `isFinished` answers "are we done yet?" and when it says yes, `end` runs once to clean up.
say.bit: A command class overrides the parts it needs. WPILib calls them for you.

say.never: Read the finished one first. Hold down **Ctrl** and tap **P**. A small search box pops up at the top. Type `TurnToAngleCommand`, then press **Enter**. It finds any file by its name, so you never have to dig through folders.
say.bit: Read the finished one first. Press **Ctrl+P**, type `TurnToAngleCommand` and press Enter. Quick Open finds any file by name, so you never have to dig through folders.

say.never: Look through the code for where it works out the **error** (how far off the robot is) and turns that into a motor command. When you've spotted it, press **I did it**.
